result.topic_en: Riemann determines the general form of an nth-order linear differential equation whose solutions are branched only at given points a, b, ..., g with prescribed exponents, counts the degrees of the polynomial coefficients and the free constants, and begins treating the behaviour at a singular point a.

methods.what: Multiplying the Wronskian-type determinant by powers of (x-a),...,(x-g) to obtain a single-valued, everywhere finite function X_n (a polynomial)
Exponent of the determinant at a singular point in terms of the local exponents
Normal form of the linear ODE with polynomial coefficients, where ω = (x-a)(x-b)...(x-g)
Count of conditions versus arbitrary constants in the coefficients
Local form of the equation near the singular point x=a

items.quote: Es wird die nächste Aufgabe der auf diese Grundlagen zu gründenden Theorie der linearen Differentialgleichungen sein, die einfachsten Systeme jeder Klasse aufzusuchen.
items.english: The next task of the theory of linear differential equations to be founded on these principles will be to find the simplest systems of each class.

items.quote:
Man ermittelt jetzt welchen Bedingungen die [-...-] Coefficienten dieser Functionen genügen

items.english: One now determines which conditions the coefficients of these functions must satisfy so that [branching] occurs only at the values a, b, ..., g, and the given exponents occur there.

items.quote: Man hat daher nur den Fall $a_0 = 0$ zu untersuchen.
items.english: One therefore only has to investigate the case a_0 = 0.
